lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa baanee sree naamadeu jee kee ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, The Word Of The Reverend Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਆਪਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek anek biaapak poorak jat dekhau tat soee ||
lines.translation: In the one and in the many, He is pervading and permeating; wherever I look, there He is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa chitr bachitr bimohit biralaa boojhai koee ||1||
lines.translation: The marvellous image of Maya is so fascinating; how few understand this. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh gobi(n)d hai sabh gobi(n)d hai gobi(n)d bin nahee koee ||
lines.translation: God is everything, God is everything. Without God, there is nothing at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਮਣਿ ਸਤ ਸਹੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soot ek man sat saha(n)s jaise ot pot prabh soee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As one thread holds hundreds and thousands of beads, He is woven into His creation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਰੁ ਫੇਨ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal tara(n)g ar phen budabudaa jal te bhi(n)n na hoee ||
lines.translation: The waves of the water, the foam and bubbles, are not distinct from the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ihu parapa(n)ch paarabraham kee leelaa bicharat aan na hoee ||2||
lines.translation: This manifested world is the playful game of the Supreme Lord God; reflecting upon it, we find that it is not different from Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa bharam ar supan manorath sat padaarath jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: False doubts and dream objects - man believes them to be true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਨਸਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sukrit manasaa gur upadesee jaagat hee man maaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru has instructed me to try to do good deeds, and my awakened mind has accepted this. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naamadeu har kee rachanaa dekhahu ridai beechaaree ||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, see the Creation of the Lord, and reflect upon it in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar keval ek muraaree ||4||1||
lines.translation: In each and every heart, and deep within the very nucleus of all, is the One Lord. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਕੁੰਭ ਭਰਾਈਲੇ ਊਦਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaneele ku(n)bh bharaaeele oodak thaakur kau isanaan karau ||
lines.translation: Bringing the pitcher, I fill it with water, to bathe the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਇਆਲੀਸ ਲਖ ਜੀ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: baiaalees lakh jee jal mahi hote beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||1||
lines.translation: But 4.2 million species of beings are in the water - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਉ ਤਤ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jatr jaau tat beethal bhailaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever I go, the Lord is there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d kare sad kelaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He continually plays in supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਫੂਲ ਪਰੋਈਲੇ ਮਾਲਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaneele phool paroeele maalaa thaakur kee hau pooj karau ||
lines.translation: I bring flowers to weave a garland, in worshipful adoration of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਹ ਬੀਠਲ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pahile baas laee hai bhavarah beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||2||
lines.translation: But the bumble bee has already sucked out the fragrance - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੀਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਰੀਧਾਈਲੇ ਖੀਰੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਨੈਵੇਦੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaneele doodh reedhaaeele kheera(n) thaakur kau naived karau ||
lines.translation: I carry milk and cook it to make pudding, with which to feed the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਟਾਰਿਓ ਬਛਰੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਭੈਲਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pahile doodh bitaario bachharai beethal bhailaa kaai karau ||3||
lines.translation: But the calf has already tasted the milk - how can I use it for the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਊਭੈ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਬੀਠਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: eebhai beethal oobhai beethal beethal bin sa(n)saar nahee ||
lines.translation: The Lord is here, the Lord is there; without the Lord, there is no world at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar naamaa pranavai poor rahio too(n) sarab mahee ||4||2||
lines.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, O Lord, You are totally permeating and pervading all places and interspaces. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਗਜੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mero gaj jihabaa meree kaatee ||
lines.translation: My mind is the yardstick, and my tongue is the scissors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਪਿ ਮਪਿ ਕਾਟਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: map map kaatau jam kee phaasee ||1||
lines.translation: I measure it out and cut off the noose of death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਹ ਕਰਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa karau jaatee kah karau paatee ||
lines.translation: What do I have to do with social status? What do I have to with ancestry?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ko naam japau din raatee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਂਗਨਿ ਰਾਂਗਉ ਸੀਵਨਿ ਸੀਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raa(n)gan raa(n)gau seevan seevau ||
lines.translation: I dye myself in the color of the Lord, and sew what has to be sewn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਰੀਅ ਨ ਜੀਵਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin gharee na jeevau ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Lord's Name, I cannot live, even for a moment. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat karau har ke gun gaavau ||
lines.translation: I perform devotional worship, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar apanaa khasam dhiaavau ||3||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੀ ਸੂਈ ਰੁਪੇ ਕਾ ਧਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: suine kee sooee rupe kaa dhaagaa ||
lines.translation: My needle is gold, and my thread is silver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naame kaa chit har sau laagaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv's mind is attached to the Lord. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ||
lines.translation: Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਪੁ ਕੁੰਚ ਛੋਡੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਡੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saap ku(n)ch chhodai bikh nahee chhaadai ||
lines.translation: The snake sheds its skin, but does not lose its venom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਾਡੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: udak maahi jaise bag dhiaan maadai ||1||
lines.translation: The heron appears to be meditating, but it is concentrating on the water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਜਪੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe kau keejai dhiaan japa(n)naa ||
lines.translation: Why do you practice meditation and chanting,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab te sudh naahee man apanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: when your mind is not pure? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਘਚ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)ghach bhojan jo nar jaanai ||
lines.translation: That man who feeds like a lion,

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਠਗਦੇਉ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aise hee thagadeu bakhaanai ||2||
lines.translation: is called the god of thieves. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਲੇ ਝਗਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naame ke suaamee laahi le jhagaraa ||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master has settled my inner conflicts.
